claims.claim_vi: The cascade is an algorithm deciding which declaration wins across origins, cascade layers and blocks; specificity is compared within the origin/layer that has precedence; order of appearance decides when specificity and scoping proximity tie.

claims.claim_vi: Inline styles override normal author-stylesheet declarations; !important is an exception to normal specificity.

design_notes_vi: Một quy tắc rồi ba bước cascade, kèm ví dụ .note thắng p; cascade layer và scoping proximity được lược khỏi hình và nói trong phần sâu. Không dùng ảnh nguồn.
source_deviations: Source calls CSS a 'markup language'; CSS is a style sheet language, so the lesson says so in the optional section.

Source says the winner is decided by selector type and source order and implies later rules win; the lesson states the actual order (origin and importance, specificity, then order) and shows that an earlier more specific rule still wins.
Source's 'CSS3 introduces animation' is omitted because it is not needed for the main idea and was not verified.
